data.name: Ananya
data.gender_notes: Ananya is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit an, 'not', + anya, 'other' — 'not other, unique, incomparable'. Its root is Sanskrit an + anya. A classical Sanskrit epithet of the goddess. Ananya is a Sanskrit name meaning “Unique; incomparable; matchless”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ananya expresses “Unique; incomparable; matchless”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit an, 'not', + anya, 'other' — 'not other, unique, incomparable'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ananya total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

vedic_reference.note: Ananya is a female name of Hindu origin, derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Anasanga’ and ‘Anapann’, meaning ‘Without attachment’ and ‘Without breath’, respectively. This name is not directly mentioned in any Vedic scripture or mythology, but it is rooted in the philosophical and spiritual traditions of ancient India.
